hivemindAdaptations: Clean-room HivemindOS-authored implementation of the cross-family adversarial thesis-gate pattern from public agent-research workflow writeups; no upstream text or code is vendored.
Reads reviewer API keys only through the shared hive env (hive-env-run); never asks agents to paste key values.
Hard-refuses Anthropic-family reviewer models to preserve cross-family independence from the Claude synthesis layer.
Fail-closed exit-code contract: only an explicit PUBLISHABLE verdict exits 0; unreachable reviewers or unparseable verdicts block instead of passing.
